## Purpose
The single owner of the `domain` scheme's concept tree: 87 concepts in three levels (industry → domain → subdomain), plus the special System node for foundation-tier agents.

## Settings that matter
- **Concept fields:** `id`, `scheme: domain`, `parent` (null for an industry), `label`, `definition` and `synonyms`.
- **Shape:**
  - the level is derived from depth and never stored;
  - 30 ids have two dotted parts (industries and domains), and 57 have three (subdomains).
- **The 14 industries** (`parent: null`):
  - `domain.bfsi`;
  - `domain.healthcare`, `domain.technology`, `domain.retail`, `domain.manufacturing`, `domain.energy`;
  - `domain.public_sector`, `domain.telecom`, `domain.logistics`, `domain.real_estate`;
  - `domain.travel`, `domain.education`;
  - `domain.cross_functional`;
  - `domain.system`.
- **Domains under the industries:**
  - under BFSI: banking, lending, insurance, capital_markets, payments, wealth;
  - under telecom: content;
  - under cross-functional: customer_support, legal, compliance, hr, finance_ops, marketing, procurement, internal;
  - subdomains under these, such as `domain.banking.kyc` and `domain.lending.mortgage`.
- **Synonyms are matched against goals** by `matcher.score_concepts`, so they are written as the phrases people actually use.
- **A synonym starting with `!` replaces the default phrase set** instead of adding to it. It is used where a label is an ordinary English word:
  - content: "!editorial content", "!content publishing", …;
  - education: "!admissions", …;
  - cross_functional: "!cross functional", "!back office";
  - internal: "!internal tooling", "!platform operations".
- **`domain.system`** has `synonyms: ["!"]`, which makes it unmatchable.

## Read by
- `catalog/seed_loader.load_seed`, which globs the directory in name order.
- The matcher, scoping (`scope_for_goal`), annotation and the graph taxonomy sync.

## Environment-specific differences
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Ids already in use were re-parented, never renamed.** Annotations point at ids, so renaming one would orphan reviewed work; for example `domain.lending` stays and gains `domain.bfsi` above it.
- **System is a sibling of the industries, not an industry.** Foundation agents live there. A goal can never scope to System, and `scope_for_goal` adds this subtree to every scope.
- **The domain scheme has one owner.** It is declared only here: when both this file and `schemes.yaml` declared domain concepts, whichever loaded last silently won.
- **The loader merges in sorted name order and later files win,** so `schemes.yaml` loads after this file. Do not add domain concepts there.
- **Cross-functional is an industry-level node of its own,** so a customer-support agent does not have to claim a sector it does not serve.

## How to rebuild this file
1. Copy the file verbatim from the source, including the header comments, the section banners, every concept and its exact synonyms (with the `!` prefixes).
2. Keep the ids stable.
